mechanism: In-process asyncio.create_task with PostgreSQL job state tracking
durability_gap: Process restart during active ingestion leaves job in STARTED or QUEUED state.
mitigation: POST /documents/{id}/reprocess endpoint allows re-queuing and executing interrupted jobs.
staging_suitability: ACCEPTABLE for staging deployment with documented limitations.
production_recommendation: Deploy standalone background worker (e.g. Celery / ARQ / SAQ) for high-volume enterprise production.
